prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for a 2D HD pixel-art xianxia combat game. Style references: image1 approved original courtyard, image2 its forest. Create ONE coherent complete woodland battlefield, fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter view, landscape 16:10 composition, crisp finely shaded pixel art matching references. A broad naturally shaped flat forest clearing fills the center, warm muted earth and short mossy grass, soft paths, subtle tiny ground detail, diffuse warm daylight from upper-left. Trees, mossy rocks and ferns frame the outer edge organically, a shaded forest exit opens on the LEFT. NO people, monsters, buildings, UI, labels or text. NO horizon or sky; every image pixel shows nearby ground/forest, not distant scenery. Technical geometry: image covers battle coordinates x=-2..14, y=-2..10; the central region x=.6..11.4 y=.6..7.4 (16.25%..83.75% horizontal, 21.7%..78.3% vertical) must be completely clear low grass/earth, all points walkable with absolutely no rocks, shrubs, trees, pits or water in that central region. Tall scenery stays outside those central percentages, canopies do not cover player bodies in the clear central region. Central ground gently blends into peripheral grass without hard geometric borders. Fine patches and leaf flecks vary naturally, no tiled repeating motifs, no grid. The playable battlefield spans 12x8m; a 1.8m tall standing person will be rendered about100px high in the center so nearby tree trunks and rocks should feel proportional. Render 1600x1000 or similar high resolution.

review.visual: Generated image inspected; complete pixel scene / transparent three-pose atlas retained.

registration.camera: image cover crop; formal points share exact forward/inverse registration
